subject: Puff the Friendly Baby Dragon
character_dna: adorable chubby baby dragon, pear-shaped squishy body, two tiny rounded smooth horns, three smooth rounded spinal bumps, tiny rounded fairy wings, smooth tail ending in a soft heart-shaped tip, oversized curious round eyes, happy smiling mouth, zero scales, zero texture lines, ultra-thick 6pt smooth 2D vector outlines
habitat_rules: Minimalist fairytale meadows and smooth rolling hills, big fluffy cartoon clouds, simple oversized flowers, zero background clutter, zero shading, wide open coloring areas with thick clean borders

scenes.micro_prompt: Color Puff's cozy cloud bed pure white and draw 1 happy sun above him!

scenes.micro_prompt: Trace the cute heart puff and color it your favorite bright red!
